notes: The page names the relative objects called courbe relative standart, describes their compactifié normalisé with additional structure, and then begins section 2 on the graph attached to a standart curve. It returns to an algebraically closed base field, defines S by pi_0(Y) and a component description in (7), and gives the canonical maps among finite sets in (8). This is a transcription summary, not a mathematical verification.

The marginal note qualifies full faithfulness over a reduced base and mentions dual numbers, a proper context and replacing the data by (hat X,I) at the level of its explicit formulas. The actual marginal words after il faut and i.e. are elliptical: no se placer or remplacer is supplied. These removals are based on separation of the crossing ink, not on grammar.

The opening tuple and the glyph after Soit are heavily reworked. No independent strike sufficient to delete either complete glyph was identified. Their live readings remain doubtful and no underlying letter is invented.

The empty-set symbol is transcribed by a literal-shape doubt phi/varnothing. Root communicated the matching ambiguous loop/stem on the previously adjudicated page007; reader A did not inspect that page.

The horizontal diagram label is read o from its rounded shape and its contrast with the nearby angular sigma. Root communicated independent confirmation from four o labels on page009; reader A did not inspect that page. No mathematical expectation was used to repair the label.

The upper author number 3 is dark and in the main hand. The light bottom-left 7 is retained, but its hand is unidentified; the common manuscript-pagination macro records its location without determining authorship.

The 35-line count includes ten upper body rows (one canceled row), two separate insertion rows, one title row, three lower body rows, Posons, display (7), two diagram-introduction rows, three diagram object rows, ten slanted marginal rows and two pagination numerals. Diagram object rows are counted independently even when sharing vertical height with nearby prose.

Blind box B01 deliberately includes the whole upper paragraph together with the crossing margin and page number, so its exact reading accounts for the overlapping main-text ink. The other boxes preserve entire doubtful formulas and all written numbers and indices. No second-pass crops were made.

H editorial prose and page descriptions are not transcribed. Its note concerning a restored Y is acknowledged as editorial evidence of its uncertainty, not as evidence for source letters. Actual quote shapes are recorded where they differ; diagram wrappers and mathematical macro synonyms alone are not collation rows.
